# Library Failure Learning Ledger

V377 active browser investigation, LIB-FAIL-2458 / FAIL742: Firefox Browser.removeBrowserContext fails with SessionStore undefined window during connected operation teardown. Other browser projects passed, but complete gate remains failed. Preserve trace and apply prior lifecycle evidence without suppressing errors or manufacturing a PASS.

V377 pending freshness correction, LIB-FAIL-2457 / FAIL741: current BFF dependency bill retained16.3.2 after the exact V376 package/lock repair. Update that derived current row to16.3.4; preserve the historical V117 build statement and verify unchanged dependency bytes.

V377 pending local qualification, LIB-FAIL-2456 / FAIL740: a provisional no-store assertion differed from the verified Next metadata loader's mandatory-revalidation header. Preserve raw headers/rejections and verify exact header plus runtime origin changes. No product privacy or cache-purge guarantee is inferred.

V377 pending local qualification, LIB-FAIL-2455 / FAIL739: header-name casing in the external HTTP probe caused rejection before its first scenario receipt. Preserve the failed stage; use the standard case-insensitive HTTPMessage interface and new immutable run paths. No server/source behavior is waived.

V377 pending local qualification, LIB-FAIL-2454 / FAIL738: exactOptionalPropertyTypes rejects explicit undefined environment values in the candidate indexing helper. Preserve strict compiler settings; correct the input type, then require tests/typecheck/build before canonical publication. No PASS inferred from unit tests alone.

## 1. Alcance

Índice persistente de fallos y condiciones reales observados al construir y auditar Elite Engineering Library y sus upstreams oficiales fijados. El detalle reproducible vive en la evidencia enlazada. Este ledger no convierte un fallo upstream en defecto propio ni una corrección propia en código atribuible al upstream.

Estados: `REGRESSION_PROVEN`, `UPSTREAM_OPEN`, `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL`, `REJECTED_COMPONENT`. Las entradas negativas esperadas de validators no aparecen porque son pruebas verdes, no fallos.

## 4. Consulta obligatoria

Antes de seleccionar una fuente o lane presente en este ledger, el agente traslada la condición correspondiente a `PROJECT_FAILURE_LESSONS.md`, `PROJECT_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_LOCK.md` y sus gates. Una revisión upstream nueva no hereda el PASS ni el fallo: se abre una entrada nueva y se revalida.

Este índice no sustituye la búsqueda de nuevos fallos. Todo fallo posterior se registra primero en el proyecto o evidencia de mantenimiento y luego se promueve conforme a `FAILURE_LEARNING_CONTRACT.md`.
